definition: Stable scenario key used across config, manifests, inputs, outputs, and audits.
description: Identifies a clinical diagnostic-reasoning scenario such as a chest-pain or dysphagia matrix.
derivation_or_transformation: Copied into generated manifests by input-building scripts.
validation_rules: Must be present in canonical manifests.
notes: Primary join key across workflows.

definition: Repository-relative path to the raw LR matrix workbook used for a generated input.
description: Points to a workbook under data/raw/lr_matrices or an older top-level data workbook when retained for compatibility.
validation_rules: File must exist before build scripts run.
notes: Prefer data/raw/lr_matrices for active inputs.

definition: Worksheet in the source workbook used for parsing categories and findings.
description: Supports workbooks with multiple schema sheets.
missing_values: blank may mean default sheet in older workflows
validation_rules: Sheet must be readable by pandas/openpyxl.
notes: Check workbook-specific meaning before publication reuse.

definition: Named parsing convention for category/finding extraction.
description: Controls how scripts detect category rows, key-feature rows, and category spans.
missing_values: blank not allowed for differential workflow
validation_rules: Must correspond to supported parser logic.
notes: Profile semantics are code-defined.

definition: First diagnosis/category in a pairwise differential comparison.
description: Used only in the differential workflow.
validation_rules: Must be nonblank for each pairs_manifest row.
notes: Exact labels inherit source workbook wording.

definition: Second diagnosis/category in a pairwise differential comparison.
description: Used only in the differential workflow.
validation_rules: Must be nonblank for each pairs_manifest row.
notes: Exact labels inherit source workbook wording.

definition: Number of findings extracted into a generated input workbook.
description: Used in manifests to summarize scenario/pair size.
missing_values: blank not allowed in canonical manifests
validation_rules: Must be nonnegative.
notes: Can differ by parser profile and schema.

definition: Repository-relative path to a pairwise differential input workbook.
description: The workbook given to model-backed LR estimation.
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from source workbook, categories, and findings.
validation_rules: Must exist before differential batch run or audit.
notes: Generated public review artifact.

definition: Manifest-declared path for a model-filled differential output workbook.
description: Used to locate expected outputs during auditing and packaging.
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from input workbook path and model-scoped output root.
validation_rules: Must resolve to expected workbook path for audit.
notes: Prefer model-scoped outputs_by_model paths.

definition: Repository-relative path to a normalized one-vs-rest scenario workbook.
description: Each workbook contains diagnosis columns and finding rows for one scenario/schema.
validation_rules: Must exist before one-vs-rest batch run or audit.
notes: Generated public review artifact.

definition: Worksheet name assigned to a normalized one-vs-rest schema.
description: Allows one workbook to contain multiple schema interpretations.
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from schema order, row index, and category count.
validation_rules: Must exist in normalized input workbook.
notes: Sheet naming is implementation-defined.

definition: Sequential index for a discovered one-vs-rest schema within a source worksheet.
description: Orders multiple schema detections for the same source workbook/sheet.
validation_rules: Must be stable within a build run.
notes: Compare with source workbook if interpretation matters.

definition: Zero-based row index in the source worksheet used to infer category labels for a one-vs-rest schema.
description: Documents provenance of a generated schema.
validation_rules: Must be within source worksheet bounds.
notes: Index is zero-based in code/manifests.

definition: Number of diagnosis categories in a one-vs-rest schema.
description: Used for QA and coherence projection shape checks.
validation_rules: Must be positive.
notes: Exact disease-category semantics inherit source workbook labels.

definition: Position of a category within a one-vs-rest schema.
description: Used to align priors, raw LRs, and coherent projections.
validation_rules: Must be unique within a schema.
notes: Ordering is analytically meaningful for matrix alignment.

definition: Diagnosis/category label in a one-vs-rest schema or prior manifest.
description: Represents the target category for priors and LR columns.
derivation_or_transformation: Extracted from parsed source workbook labels.
validation_rules: Must align with input workbook column labels.
notes: Exact labels inherit source workbook wording.

definition: Prior probability value as read from the source workbook.
description: Used by coherence projection when available.
missing_values: blank allowed when missing source prior
validation_rules: Should be positive if present.
notes: Definition can vary by source workbook and should be reviewed.

definition: Prior probability after normalization within a schema.
description: Used by Bayes-coherent one-vs-rest projection.
missing_values: blank not allowed when prior projection is used
validation_rules: Should sum to 1 within scenario/schema, subject to rounding.
notes: Core coherence input.

definition: Sum of raw prior values before normalization for a schema.
description: QA field for prior normalization.
validation_rules: Should be positive when priors are used.
notes: Review if raw source uses odds or unscaled weights.

definition: Model/run identifier used to scope generated outputs and quality summaries.
description: Separates outputs from different LLM model runs.
allowed_values: Provider model IDs or local run names
missing_values: blank not allowed in model-scoped outputs
derivation_or_transformation: Used in output directory and manifest names.
validation_rules: Should be explicit and reproducible in run notes.
notes: Examples in README are illustrative, not fixed.

definition: Positive numeric likelihood ratio estimated by model output or produced by coherence projection.
description: Main analytic value in generated output workbooks.
missing_values: missing, nonnumeric, zero, or negative values fail audits
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed from workbook cells by audit scripts.
validation_rules: Must be positive numeric for passing output cells.
notes: Workbook-specific cell locations are defined by manifests.

definition: Boolean flag indicating whether a workbook or cell passed structural LR checks.
description: Used in quality summaries for differential and one-vs-rest workflows.
missing_values: blank not allowed in quality summaries
validation_rules: Failed rows should be reviewed before use.
notes: May summarize workbook-level or cell-level status depending on file.

definition: Short audit explanation for a missing, invalid, or structurally unparseable LR cell.
description: Helps target repairs or exclusions.
missing_values: blank when no invalidity is present
validation_rules: Should be nonblank for invalid rows.
notes: Exact vocabulary is audit-script defined.

definition: One-vs-rest LR value after Bayes-coherent projection.
description: Projection aligns independently estimated one-vs-rest LRs with a multiclass posterior distribution.
missing_values: blank when projection not run or failed
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from raw one-vs-rest outputs and normalized priors.
validation_rules: Must be positive numeric in coherent output workbooks.
notes: Do not overwrite raw model outputs.

definition: Status field describing whether a scenario/finding projection succeeded, failed, or was skipped.
description: Used in coherence quality and invalid-row manifests.
validation_rules: Failures should be reviewed before publication-facing summaries.
notes: Exact status labels are implementation-defined.

definition: Simulated encounter transcript or assessment PDF used by extraction notebooks.
description: Input family for assessment feature extraction.
missing_values: blank not allowed when processing an encounter
validation_rules: Should contain no secrets or private manuscript material.
notes: Content sensitivity should be checked before public expansion.

definition: Excel template used to structure extracted features and LR labels.
description: Defines workbook layout for assessment outputs.
missing_values: blank not allowed for assessment workflow
validation_rules: File should remain immutable as raw input.
notes: Filename has historical misspelling asssessment.

definition: Workbook populated with transcript-derived findings and LR labels.
description: Generated output from assessment notebooks.
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from transcript PDFs and templates.
validation_rules: Should be reviewed for sensitivity before sharing outside repo context.
notes: Retained as public workflow artifact in current branch.

definition: Packaged workflow handoff containing selected code, manifests, and outputs.
description: Generated by packaging scripts for external review or reproducibility handoff.
derivation_or_transformation: Created from workflow-specific manifests and outputs.
validation_rules: Must not be full repo snapshots or include private drafts/secrets.
notes: Ignored by default unless intentionally released/tracked.

definition: CSV manifest with one row per diagnosis-pair workbook for the differential LR workflow.
description: Records scenario, source workbook, categories, input workbook, and expected output workbook.
missing_values: file missing means differential batch cannot run from canonical manifest
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from scenario registry and parsed source workbooks.
validation_rules: Required columns include scenario_id, pair_index, source_workbook, source_sheet, category_left, category_right, input_workbook, output_workbook.
notes: Canonical manifest for pairwise differential LR runs.

definition: CSV manifest with one row per scenario schema for the one-vs-rest LR workflow.
description: Records source workbook, worksheet, schema location, category count, finding count, and normalized input workbook.
missing_values: file missing means one-vs-rest batch cannot run from canonical manifest
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from source workbooks and scenario config.
validation_rules: Required columns include scenario_id, source_workbook, source_sheet, schema_sheet_name, findings_count, normalized_input_workbook.
notes: Canonical manifest for one-vs-rest LR runs.

definition: CSV manifest with one row per category prior in each one-vs-rest schema.
description: Provides normalized priors used by Bayes-coherent projection.
missing_values: file missing limits or blocks coherence projection depending on command flags
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from parsed prior rows in source workbooks.
validation_rules: Required columns include scenario_id, source_workbook, source_sheet, schema_sheet_name, category_order, category, prior_raw, prior_normalized.
notes: Review raw prior semantics before publication-facing interpretation.
